page0.text:
The sky is still gray.
We leave the now deserted church.

page1.text:
"Oh. So you're done with your business, boy?"
...There.
In the clearing in front of us is the familiar spearman.

page2.text:
"...!"
Saber glares at him while supporting me.
She's so tense that she would slash him without hesitation if he took another step.

page3.text:
"...No, you're mistaken, Saber. He helped us."
"Huh...? Do you mean Lancer cooperated with you, Shirou?"

page4.text:
"...Yeah, that's right. If you can, don't fight him, please."
Saber stares at Lancer in astonishment.
...It seems like he's fully enjoying Saber's reaction.

page5.text: "I understand, but... Why, Lancer? Is cooperating with Shirou and Rin part of some scheme?"

page6.text: "Huh? Oh, are you stupid? Of course I am. I won't help someone unless I'm scheming something secretly."

page7.text:
"...Ha."
I knew he was that kind of guy, but he's thorough as he's making fun of Saber as well.

page8.text:
"Mrgh. What is so funny, Shirou?"
"Huh... Was I laughing...?"

page9.text:
"Yes, you were. I suppose I was mistaken. It seems as though I do not need to support you if you are well enough to laugh."
...It's bad, but that made me a bit relieved.

page10.text:
Saber is the same as before.
Our connection is gone, but she's here just like before.
Then...what's there to regret?

page11.text: "...My bad, I guess I let my guard down. Now's not the time, huh?"

page12.text:
"...Yes. We should rest for now, even if we are to get Rin back... Lancer, I do not know what your objective is, but you should be done with your business. Then leave. I will not fight you now."
She declares in a dignified manner and goes down to the clearing.

page13.text:
"...Huh? Hey, everything went well...or I guess not. What happened, boy?"
"Archer took Tohsaka away. We're just going to get her back."
I bear my dizziness and answer looking into Lancer's eyes.

page14.text:
"...What? Hold on, what's going on?"
...
...I'm sorry, but I don't have any energy left.
I can't give such a long explanation, so I should go home and...

page15.text:
"Archer's objective is to kill Shirou. In order to do that, he has abducted my Master, Rin, and requested a duel with Shirou in exchange.
Her safety will not be guaranteed if we do not go to him within a day."

page16.text:
...Well.
It was helpful of you to explain on my behalf, but there's no point in telling Lancer that, Saber.

page17.text:
"...Damn, he really did it this time."
...Then.
He takes off his friendly face and grits his teeth.

page18.text:
"...Lancer?"
"So, what? He betrayed his young lady not once, but twice?"
"Uh.... Yes, that would be the case. What about it...?"

page19.text:
"...Don't 'what about it' me...damn it, I changed my mind.
This was the only help I was going to offer, but let me help you a little longer. I won't be able to have peace of mind like this."
Lancer spits out and starts walking.

page20.text:
...
Saber stares at Lancer silently.
...I understand how she feels.
Lancer's back looked as if he was telling us that he'll join us.

page21.text: "...I am troubled. What kind of magecraft did you and Rin use to get him on our side?"
